description: Create an HTML5 display upload ad (DisplayUploadAd, HTML5_UPLOAD_AD) in a DISPLAY ad group from a previously-uploaded MEDIA_BUNDLE asset. This is the real animated HTML5 creative served via API — no manual UI upload. Note: the account must be eligible for HTML5 upload ads (enforced at create time; a policy error means it is not yet allowlisted). Refs #5744.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

finalUrl.description: Landing page URL (must match the clickTag domain).

mediaBundleAsset.description: resource_name of the uploaded MEDIA_BUNDLE asset (from gads_upload_media_bundle).

name: gads_create_html5_ad
